questions.stem: 设  \( \lim_{x\to\infty}f'(x)=0 \) ，且  \( \lim_{x\to\infty}\left(\frac{ax^{2}}{1+x}-bx-1\right)=\lim_{x\to\infty}[f(x+1)-f(x)] \) ，则曲线  \( y=\frac{ax^{2}}{1+x} \)  的斜渐近线方程为

solution.analysis_md:
由拉格朗日中值定理,有
\[
f (x + 1) - f (x) = f ^ {\prime} (\xi), \quad x <   \xi <   x + 1
\]
当 \(x \to \infty\) 时, \(\xi \to \infty\), 故
\[
\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} [ f (x + 1) - f (x) ] = \lim _ {\xi \rightarrow \infty} f ^ {\prime} (\xi) = 0
\]
由 \(\lim_{x\to \infty}\left(\frac{ax^2}{1 + x} -bx - 1\right) = \lim_{x\to \infty}\frac{(a - b)x^2 - (b + 1)x - 1}{1 + x} = 0\)
得 \(a - b = 0, b + 1 = 0\)，故 \(a = -1, b = -1\).
由 \(\lim_{x\to \infty}\left(\frac{ax^2}{1 + x} -bx - 1\right) = \lim_{x\to \infty}\left[\frac{-x^2}{1 + x} -(-x + 1)\right] = 0\) ，知 \(y = \frac{ax^2}{1 + x}\stackrel {2x2}{=}\frac{-x^2}{1 + x}\) 的斜渐近线
方程为  \( y = -x + 1 \) .
A 正确.

由已知, \( x_{n}>0 \) ,则
\[
\sqrt {\frac {x _ {n + 1}}{x _ {n}}} \leqslant \frac {1}{2} \left(x _ {n + 1} + \frac {1}{x _ {n}}\right) <   1 (n = 1, 2, \dots) \tag {①}
\]
故 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 单调递减有下界 \(0, \lim_{n \to \infty} x_{n}\) 存在.
记 \( \lim_{n\to\infty}x_n=A \) ，则A>0（见【注】），式①取极限 \( (n\to\infty) \) ，有 \( \lim_{n\to\infty}\sqrt{\frac{x_{n+1}}{x_n}}=\sqrt{\frac{A}{A}}=1. \)
由夹逼准则,有
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{2} \left(x _ {n + 1} + \frac {1}{x _ {n}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(A + \frac {1}{A}\right) = 1
\]
解得 A=1，即 B 正确。
【注】若 \(A = 0, x_{n+1} + \frac{1}{x_n} < 2\)，两边取极限 \((n \to \infty)\)，有 \(+\infty \leqslant 2\)，矛盾。故 \(A > 0\)。

questions.stem: 设 \(\Sigma\) 为球面 \(x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = R^{2}\), 取外侧, 下列选项中两个积分均为零的是

solution.analysis_md:
\(\Sigma\) 关于 \(yOz\) 面对称, 因被积函数 \(x\) 与 \(xy\) 关于 \(x\) 是奇函数, 故
\[
\iint_ {\Sigma} x \mathrm{d} S = 0, \quad \iint_ {\Sigma} x y \mathrm{d} S = 0
\]
又因被积函数 \(x^{2}\) 关于 \(x\) 是偶函数，故
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {\Sigma} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} S = 2 \iint_ {\Sigma \cap \{x \geqslant 0 \}} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} S = 2 \iint_ {y ^ {2} + z ^ {2} \leqslant R ^ {2}} (R ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}) \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial y}\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {\partial x}{\partial z}\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z > 0 \\ \iint_ {\Sigma} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = \iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z \\ \end{array}
\]
这里 \(\Sigma\) 取外侧, \(\Sigma_{1}, \Sigma_{2}\) 分别为前、后半球面. \(\Sigma\) 在 \(yOz\) 面投影区域为 \(D: y^{2} + z^{2} \leqslant R^{2}\).
故 \(\iint_{\Sigma} x^2 \, \mathrm{d}y \, \mathrm{d}z = \iint_{D} (R^2 - y^2 - z^2) \, \mathrm{d}y \, \mathrm{d}z - \iint_{D} (R^2 - y^2 - z^2) \, \mathrm{d}y \, \mathrm{d}z = 0\). D 正确.
\[
\begin{array}{l} \iint_ {\Sigma} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = \iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z + \iint_ {\Sigma_ {2}} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z = \iint_ {D} \sqrt {R ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z - \iint_ {D} (- \sqrt {R ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}}) \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z \\ = 2 \iint_ {D} \sqrt {R ^ {2} - y ^ {2} - z ^ {2}} d y d z = 2 \iint_ {\Sigma_ {1}} x d y d z > 0 \\ \end{array}
\]
同样可知 \(\iint_{\Sigma} y \, \mathrm{d}x \, \mathrm{d}x > 0\).

questions.stem: 设 \( f(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n x^{n+1} \) 在 [0,1] 上收敛，则级数 \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) \)

solution.analysis_md:
依题设, \( f(x) \stackrel{\text{设}}{\approx} \sum_{n=1}^{\text{设}} a_n x^{n+1} \) 在 \( x = 1 \) 处收敛, 即 \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n \) 收敛, 故 \( \lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = 0 \), 从而 \( |a_n| \leqslant M (M \geqslant 0) \).
\[
\left| (- 1) ^ {n - 1} f \left(\frac {1}{n}\right) \right| = \left| \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {c _ {n}} a _ {k} \left(\frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {k + 1} \right| \leqslant M \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {\infty} \left(\frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {k + 1} = M \cdot \frac {\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}}{1 - \frac {1}{n}} = \frac {M}{n (n - 1)} \quad (n = 2, 3, \dots)
\]
而 \(\sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{M}{n(n-1)}\) 收敛, 故 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^{n-1} f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)\) 绝对收敛.
B 正确.

options.B: \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解均是 \(AX = 0\) 的解, 但二者不同解.
options.C: \(AX = 0\) 的解均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解, 但二者不同解.
options.D: \(AX = 0\) 与 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 没有非零公共解.

solution.analysis_md:
记 \(B = (\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3})\)，则
\[
\boldsymbol {B} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 1 \\ - 2 & - 1 & a \end{array} \right] \rightarrow \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & - 3 & - 1 \\ 0 & 3 & a + 2 \end{array} \right] \rightarrow \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & - 3 & - 1 \\ 0 & 0 & a + 1 \end{array} \right]
\]
由 \(a \neq -1\), 知 \(\mathrm{r}(\pmb{B}) = 3\), 故 \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}\) 线性无关, 从而 \(\alpha_{1} - \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{2} - \alpha_{3}\) 是对应齐次线性方程组 \(AX = 0\) 的两个线性无关解, 于是 \(\mathrm{r}(A) \leqslant 1\); 但 \(A \neq O\), 故 \(\mathrm{r}(A) \geqslant 1\), 所以 \(\mathrm{r}(A) = 1\). 从而 \(\mathrm{r}(A^{*}) = 0, A^{*} = O\), 所以任意 3 维列向量均是 \(A^{*}X = 0\) 的解.
因此, \(AX = 0\) 的解均是 \(\mathbf{A}^{*}\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{0}\) 的解, 选项C正确. 选项B不正确, 选项A不正确.
对于选项 D, 由 AX=0 的基础解系至少包含两个解向量, 知 AX=0 有无穷多个非零解. 从而 AX=0 与  \( A^{*}X=0 \)  的公共解中有无穷多个非零解. 选项 D 不正确.
【注】若 A = O，则  \( AX = b (b \neq 0) \)  无解，与已知条件矛盾，故  \( A \neq O \) .

questions.stem: 设 \(A\) 为 2 阶实矩阵, \(\alpha\) 与 \(\beta\) 是 \(A\) 的两个单位实特征向量, 且满足 \(\| \alpha + \beta \| = \| \alpha - \beta \|\), 则

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(\| \alpha +\beta \| = \| \alpha -\beta \|\) ，知 \(\| \alpha +\beta \| ^2 = \| \alpha -\beta \| ^2\) ，即
\[
(\boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \boldsymbol {\beta}) = (\boldsymbol {\alpha} - \boldsymbol {\beta}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} - \boldsymbol {\beta})
\]
故 \((\alpha + \beta)^{\mathrm{T}}(\alpha + \beta) = (\alpha - \beta)^{\mathrm{T}}(\alpha - \beta)\)
即 \(\pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha} + \pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} + \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha} + \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} = \pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha} - \pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} - \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha} + \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta}\)
也即 \(2(\pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} + \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha}) = 0\) ，而 \(\pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} = \pmb{\beta}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha}\) ，故 \(4\pmb{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta} = 0.\)
从而  \( \alpha^{T}\beta=0 \) ，所以  \( \alpha \)  与  \( \beta \)  正交（垂直），于是知 A 是 2 阶实对称矩阵，从而 A 必相似于对角矩阵。C 正确。
由于 A 的特征值未知, 故 A、B、D 不正确.
【注】令 \(Q = (\alpha, \beta)\), 则 \(Q\) 为正交矩阵, 使得
\[
\boldsymbol {Q} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {Q} = \boldsymbol {\Lambda} = \operatorname{diag} (\lambda_ {1}, \lambda_ {2})
\]
从而  \( A = Q \Lambda Q^{-1}, A^{T} = (Q^{-1})^{T} \Lambda^{T} Q^{T} = Q \Lambda Q^{-1} = A \) ，故 A 是对称矩阵.

questions.stem: 设 \(A, B, C\) 均为 3 阶矩阵, \(r(C) = 1\), \(r(B) = 2\), 且满足 \((A + E)C = O, B(A^T - 2E) = O\), 则下列矩阵中与 \(A\) 相似的是

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(r(C) = 1, (A + E)C = O\)，知 \(C\) 的列向量是 \((A + E)X = 0\) 的解，且至少有一个线性无关的解向量，即 \(A\) 有特征值 \(\lambda = -1\).
对 \(B(A^{\mathrm{T}} - 2E) = O\) 两边同时取转置，得
\[
\left[ \boldsymbol {A} - (2 \boldsymbol {E}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \right] \boldsymbol {B} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = (\boldsymbol {A} - 2 \boldsymbol {E}) \boldsymbol {B} ^ {\mathrm{T}} = \boldsymbol {O}
\]
由 \(\mathbf{r}(\pmb{B}^{\mathrm{T}}) = \mathbf{r}(\pmb{B}) = 2\) ，知 \(\pmb{B}^{\mathrm{T}}\) 的列向量是 \((\pmb {A} - 2\pmb {E})\pmb {X} = \pmb{0}\) 的解，且至少有两个线性无关的解向量，即 \(\pmb{A}\) 有特征值 \(\lambda = 2\) ，且至少为二重根.
又 \(\mathbf{r}(\mathbf{C}) + \mathbf{r}(\mathbf{B}) = 3\) ，故 \(\lambda = -1\) 是单根， \(\lambda = 2\) 是二重根，从而 \(\mathbf{A}\sim \left[ \begin{array}{ccc} - 1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & 2 & 0\\ 0 & 0 & 2 \end{array} \right].\) D正确.

questions.stem: 设随机事件 \(A, B, C\) 两两独立，且三个事件不可能同时发生，若 \(P(A) = P(B) = P(C) = p\) \((0 < p < 1)\)，则

solution.analysis_md:
由题设知, \( ABC=\varnothing \) ,则有 \( AB\cap AC=\varnothing \) .故
\[
\begin{array}{l} 0 \leqslant P (A - A B - A C) = P (A) - P (A B) - P (A C) \\ = P (A) - P (A) P (B) - P (A) P (C) = p - 2 p ^ {2} \\ \end{array}
\]
于是 \(2p^{2} \leqslant p\); 又 \(0 < p < 1\), 故 \(0 < p \leqslant \frac{1}{2}\). A 正确.

questions.stem: 设随机变量 \(X\) 的概率密度为 \(f(x), DX = 1\), 随机变量 \(Y\) 的概率密度为 \(f(-y)\), 且 \(\rho_{XY} = -\frac{1}{2}\), 则 \(D(X - Y) =\)

solution.analysis_md:
由 \(D(X - Y) = DX + DY - 2\mathrm{Cov}(X,Y) = DX + DY - 2\rho_{XY}\sqrt{DX}\sqrt{DY}\), 知需计算 \(DY\), 考虑到 \(X\) 与 \(Y\) 的概率密度, 先求 \(EX\) 与 \(EY\).
\[
E (X + Y) = E X + E Y = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f (- y) \mathrm{d} y
\]
\[
\int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f (- y) \mathrm{d} y \stackrel {- y = x} {=} \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {- \infty} (- x) f (x) \mathrm{d} (- x) = - \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x
\]
故 \(E(X + Y) = 0\) ，即 \(EX = -EY\)
\[
\text {又} E (Y ^ {2}) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y ^ {2} f (- y) \mathrm{d} y \xlongequal {- y = x} \int_ {+ \infty} ^ {- \infty} (- x) ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} (- x) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = E (X ^ {2}).
\]
故 \(DY = E(Y^2) - (EY)^2 = E(X^2) - (-EX)^2 = E(X^2) - (EX)^2 = DX = 1.\)
从而 \(D(X - Y) = 1 + 1 - 2 \times \left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)\sqrt{1} \sqrt{1} = 3.\) D正确.

questions.stem: 设  \( X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n} (n > 1) \)  为来自总体  \( N(\mu, \sigma^{2}) \)  的简单随机样本,  \( \overline{X} \)  为样本均值,  \( S^{2} \)  为样本方差, 则  \( \mu \sigma^{2} \)  的无偏估计量为

solution.analysis_md:
由已知, \( \overline{X}\sim N\left(\mu,\frac{\sigma^{2}}{n}\right) \) ，且 \( \overline{X} \) 与 \( S^{2} \) 相互独立，故
\[
E \overline {{{X}}} = \mu , \quad E (\overline {{{X}}} S ^ {2}) = E \overline {{{X}}} \cdot E (S ^ {2})
\]
又 \(\frac{(n - 1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim \chi^2 (n - 1)\) ，所以
\[
E S ^ {2} = E \left[ \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n - 1} \cdot \frac {(n - 1) S ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \right] = \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n - 1} E [ \chi^ {2} (n - 1) ] = \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n - 1} \cdot (n - 1) = \sigma^ {2}
\]
故 \(E(\overline{XS}^2) = \mu \sigma^2\) .C正确.
二、填空题

questions.stem: 设 \( y = f(x) \) 由方程 \( \mathrm{e}^{y} + x = e\cos(xy) \) 确定, 则 \( \lim_{n\to \infty}\left[f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)\right]^{\frac{1}{n(1 - \cos\frac{1}{n})}} = \) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
已知方程  \( e^{y} + x = e \cos(xy) \) ，当 x = 0 时，y = 1，即  \( f(0) = 1 \) .
上述方程两边对 \(x\) 求导, 有
\[
\mathrm{e} ^ {y} \cdot y ^ {\prime} + 1 = - \mathrm{e} (y + x y ^ {\prime}) \sin (x y)
\]
将 \(x = 0, y = 1\) 代入上式，有 \(y'(0) = f'(0) = -\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}}\)
\[
\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \left[ f \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)\right] ^ {\frac {1}{n \left(1 - \cos \frac {1}{n}\right)}} = \mathrm{e} ^ {\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {1}{\left(1 - \cos \frac {1}{n}\right)} \ln f \left(\frac {1}{n}\right)}
\]
又 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n\left(1 - \cos\frac{1}{n}\right)}\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) = \lim_{n\to \infty}2n\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) = 2\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{\ln f\left(\frac{1}{n}\right) - \ln f(0)}{\frac{1}{n}}\)
\[
= 2 \left[ \ln f (x) \right] ^ {\prime} \Big | _ {x = 0} = \frac {2 f ^ {\prime} (0)}{f (0)} = - \frac {2}{\mathrm{e}}
\]
故原式 \(= \mathrm{e}^{-\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}}\).

questions.stem:
设 \(x = f(y)\) 是单调可导函数 \(y = g(x)\) 的反函数, 且 \(g(1) = 2, g'(1) = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\), 则
\[
\lim _ {y \to 2} (y - 2) \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} = \underline {{\quad}}.
\]

solution.analysis_md:
当 \(x = 1\) 时, \(y = g(1) = 2\), 由 \(x = f(y)\) 为 \(y = g(x)\) 的反函数, 知 \(f'(y) = \frac{1}{g'(x)}\), 故
\[
f ^ {\prime} (2) = \frac {1}{g ^ {\prime} (1)} = - \frac {3}{\sqrt {3}} = - \sqrt {3}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} (y - 2) \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} = \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} \frac {f (y) - f (2)}{y - 2} \cdot \frac {(y - 2) ^ {2}}{(\ln y - \ln 2) ^ {2}} \\ = f ^ {\prime} (2) \lim _ {y \rightarrow 2} \frac {(y - 2) ^ {2}}{\left[ \ln \left(1 + \frac {y}{2} - 1\right)\right] ^ {2}} \\ = 4 f ^ {\prime} (2) = - 4 \sqrt {3} \\ \end{array}
\]

questions.stem: 设 \(a^2 + b^2 = 1 (a < 0, b > 0)\), 则曲线 \(y = x^2 + ax\) 与直线 \(y = bx\) 所围区域面积的最大值为 ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(y = x^{2} + ax\) 与 \(y = bx\) 所围区域的面积为
\[
S = \int_ {0} ^ {b - a} (b x - x ^ {2} - a x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{6} (b - a) ^ {3}
\]
求 \(\frac{1}{6} (b - a)^3\) 在条件 \(a^2 + b^2 = 1\) 下的最大值.
令 \(L = \frac{1}{6} (b - a)^{3} + \lambda (a^{2} + b^{2} - 1)\)，则
\[
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} L _ {a} ^ {\prime} = - \frac {1}{2} (b - a) ^ {2} + 2 \lambda a = 0 \\ L _ {b} ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{2} (b - a) ^ {2} + 2 \lambda b = 0 \\ L _ {\lambda} ^ {\prime} = a ^ {2} + b ^ {2} - 1 = 0 \end{array} \right.
\]
解得 \(a = -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, b = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\). 故所求面积的最大值为 \(\frac{1}{6}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)^3 = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{3}\).

questions.stem: 设平面曲线 \(L\) 为 \(r = 1 + \cos \theta\) 从 \(\theta = 0\) 到 \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) 的一段弧, 则 \(I = \int_{L} (3x^{2} - 1) \mathrm{d}x + 3y^{2} \mathrm{d}y =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(I = \int_{L}(3x^{2} - 1)\mathrm{d}x + 3y^{2}\mathrm{d}y = \int_{L}3x^{2}\mathrm{d}x + 3y^{2}\mathrm{d}y - \int_{L}\mathrm{d}x\xlongequal{\text{记}} I_{1} - I_{2}\)
由 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = r\cos \theta = (1 + \cos \theta)\cos \theta \\ y = r\sin \theta = (1 + \cos \theta)\sin \theta \end{array} \right.\) 知 \(\theta = 0\) 对应点(2,0)，\(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) 对应点(0,1)，则
\[
I _ {1} = \int_ {L} 3 x ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x + 3 y ^ {2} \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {L} \mathrm{d} (x ^ {3} + y ^ {3}) = (x ^ {3} + y ^ {3}) \Big | _ {(2, 0)} ^ {(0, 1)} = - 7
\]
又 \(\mathrm{dx} = [-\sin \theta \cos \theta +(1 + \cos \theta)(-\sin \theta)]\mathrm{d}\theta = (-2\sin \theta \cos \theta -\sin \theta)\mathrm{d}\theta\) ，故
\[
I _ {2} = \int_ {L} \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (- 2 \sin \theta \cos \theta - \sin \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta = - 2
\]
于是 \(I = I_{1} - I_{2} = -7 + 2 = -5.\)

questions.stem: 设 \(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}\) 为线性无关的 3 维列向量, \(A = (\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3})\), 交换 \(A\) 的第 2 列与第 3 列, 再将第 2 列乘以 \((-4)\)、第 3 列乘以 \((-1)\) 得 \(C\), 若 \(BA = C\), 则 \(tr(B) =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
依题设,有
\[
\boldsymbol {C} = \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{r r r} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right]
\]
\[
= \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \end{array} \right]
\]
由 \(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}\) 线性无关，知 \(A = (\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3})\) 可逆，故
\[
\boldsymbol {B} \boldsymbol {A} = \boldsymbol {C} = \boldsymbol {A} \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \\ 0 & - 4 & 0 \end{array} \right] = \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {D}
\]
从而  \( A^{-1}BA = D \) .
由 \(|\lambda E - D| = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}\lambda -1 & 0 & 0\\ 0 & \lambda & 1\\ 0 & 4 & \lambda \end{array} \right| = (\lambda -1)(\lambda -2)(\lambda +2)\)
得 \(D\) 的特征值为 1,2,-2,也是 \(\pmb{B}\) 的特征值.
故 \(\operatorname{tr}(\pmb{B}) = 1 + 2 - 2 = 1.\)

questions.stem: 设 \(X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\) 为来自总体 \(N(0,1)\) 的简单随机样本，\(\overline{X}\) 为样本均值，\(S^{2}\) 为样本方差，记 \(T = \frac{\overline{X} - S}{n}\)，则 \(E(T^{2}) =\) ____.

solution.analysis_md:
\(E(T^{2}) = E\left[\left(\frac{\overline{X} - S}{n}\right)^{2}\right] = \frac{1}{n^{2}} E\left[(\overline{X} - S)^{2}\right] = \frac{1}{n^{2}}\left[E\left(\overline{X}^{2} - 2\overline{X}S + S^{2}\right)\right]\)
\[
= \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \left[ E \overline {{{X}}} ^ {2} - 2 E (\overline {{{X}}} S) + E (S ^ {2}) \right]
\]
由已知,有  \( E\overline{X}=EX=0,D\overline{X}=\frac{1}{n},E(S^{2})=DX=1. \)
又因 \(\overline{X}\) 与 \(S^2\) 相互独立，故 \(\overline{X}\) 与 \(S\) 也相互独立，所以
\[
E (\overline {{{X}}} ^ {2}) = D \overline {{{X}}} + (E \overline {{{X}}}) ^ {2} = \frac {1}{n} + 0 = \frac {1}{n}
\]
\[
E (\overline {{{X}}} S) = E \overline {{{X}}} E S = 0
\]
故 \(E(T^2) = \frac{1}{n^2}\left(\frac{1}{n} - 0 + 1\right) = \frac{1}{n^2} + \frac{1}{n^3}\).
三、解答题

questions.stem: 设 \(f(t)\) 是连续函数, \(f(0) = 0\), \(\sum_{t}\) 为由圆柱面 \(x^{2} + y^{2} = t^{2}(t > 0)\) 与 \(z = 0\)、\(z = 1\) 所围立体的全表面, 取外侧, 且 \(f(t) = \iint_{\overline{\gamma}} 3xz^{2} \mathrm{d}y \mathrm{d}z + 3xy^{2} \mathrm{d}z \mathrm{d}x + zf\left(\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right) \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{d}y\). 求 \(f(t)\) 的表达式.

solution.analysis_md:
由已知, \(\Sigma_{t}\) 如图所示, \(\Sigma_{t}11\) 立体体积记为 \(V_{t}\),
\(D_{xy} = \{(x,y)\mid x^2 +y^2\leqslant t^2\}\) ，应用高斯公式，有
\[
f (t) = \iiint_ {V _ {t}} \left[ 3 x ^ {2} + 6 x y + f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) \right] \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z
\]
\[
= \iiint_ {V _ {t}} \left[ 3 z ^ {2} + f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) \right] \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \mathrm{d} z \quad (\text {因为} x y \text {是奇函数})
\]
\[
= \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} 3 z ^ {2} \mathrm{d} z + \iint_ {D _ {x y}} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) \mathrm{d} z
\]
\[
= \pi t ^ {2} + \iint_ {D _ {x y}} f (\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}) d x d y = \pi t ^ {2} + \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} d \theta \int_ {0} ^ {t} f (r) r d r
\]
故 \(f(t) = \pi t^2 + 2\pi \int_0^t f(r)r\mathrm{d}r\)，两边对 \(t\) 求导，得 \(f'(t) = 2\pi t + 2\pi f(t)t\).
解一阶线性微分方程 \(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} f'(t) - 2\pi tf(t) = 2\pi t, \\ f(0) = 0, \end{array} \right.\) 得 \(f(t) = \mathrm{e}^{\pi t^2} - 1 (t > 0)\).

(I) 由 \(x = t^2 (t > 0)\), 得 \(t = \sqrt{x}\), 则
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}
\]
\[
\begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} \left(\frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t}\right) \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {x}} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} t}{\mathrm{d} x} \\ = - \frac {1}{4} x ^ {- \frac {3}{2}} \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} + \frac {1}{4 x} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t \mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} \\ \end{array}
\]
将 \(\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}},\frac{\mathrm{d}^2y}{\mathrm{dx}^2},\sqrt{x} = t\) 代入原方程，化简得
\[
\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2} y}{\mathrm{d} t ^ {2}} - \frac {\mathrm{d} y}{\mathrm{d} t} - 6 y = \mathrm{e} ^ {- t} \tag {①}
\]
(Ⅱ) 方程 ① 对应的特征方程为 \(r^2 - r - 6 = 0\), 解得 \(r_1 = -2, r_2 = 3\).
令方程 ① 的特解为 \( y^{*} = t^{0} \cdot A \mathrm{e}^{-t} \)，则将 \( y^{*'} = -A \mathrm{e}^{-t}, y^{*''} = A \mathrm{e}^{-t} \) 代入方程 ①，可得 \( A = -\frac{1}{4} \).
故方程 ① 的通解为 \( y = C_1 e^{-2t} + C_2 e^{3t} - \frac{1}{4} e^{-t} \).
原方程的通解为 \( y = C_1\mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} + C_2\mathrm{e}^{3\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).
由 \(\lim_{x\to 0^{+}}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_1 + C_2 - \frac{1}{4} = 0.\)
由 \(\lim_{x\to +\infty}y(x) = 0\) ，得 \(C_2 = 0\) ，故 \(C_1 = \frac{1}{4}, C_2 = 0.\)
所求函数为 \( y(x) = \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-2\sqrt{x}} - \frac{1}{4}\mathrm{e}^{-\sqrt{x}} \).

(I) 当 \(x \in (0,1)\) 时, 由 \(f(x)\) 单调递减, 有
\[
\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (0) \mathrm{d} t = x f (0)
\]
令 \(g(x) = \frac{\int_0^x f(t)\mathrm{d}t}{x}\) ，则有
\[
\begin{array}{l} g ^ {\prime} (x) = \frac {x f (x) - \int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x ^ {2}} = \frac {x f (x) - x f (\xi)}{x ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {x [ f (x) - f (\xi) ]}{x ^ {2}} <   0, \quad 0 <   \xi <   x \\ \end{array}
\]
故 \(g(x)\) 单调递减，从而有
\[
g (x) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {x} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{x} > g (1) = \frac {\int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t}{1}
\]
即 \(x\int_{0}^{1}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   \int_{0}^{x}f(t)\mathrm{d}t.\)
(Ⅱ) 先证明 \(x_{n} \in (0,1)\).
当 \(n = 1\) 时，由（I）知
\[
0 \leqslant x _ {0} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {0}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {0} f (0) \leqslant x _ {0} <   1
\]
假设当 \(n = k\) 时，有 \(x_{k}\in (0,1)\) ，则当 \(n = k + 1\) 时，
\[
0 \leqslant x _ {k} \int_ {0} ^ {1} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {k + 1} = \int_ {0} ^ {x _ {k}} f (t) \mathrm{d} t <   x _ {k} f (0) \leqslant x _ {k} <   1
\]
由数学归纳法,知  \( x_{n} \in (0,1) \) .
由 \(x_{n} = \int_{0}^{x_{n - 1}}f(t)\mathrm{d}t <   x_{n - 1}f(0)\leqslant x_{n - 1}\) ，知 \(\{x_{n}\}\) 单调递减，故 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n\) 存在，记 \(\lim_{n\to \infty}x_n = a\) 则 \(a\geqslant 0.\) 由 \(x_{n} = \int_{0}^{x_{n - 1}}f(t)\mathrm{d}t\) ，有 \(a = \int_0^a f(t)\mathrm{d}t.\)
若 \(a \in (0,1)\), 则 \(a = \int_{0}^{a} f(t) \mathrm{d}t < af(0) \leqslant a\) 矛盾, 故 \(a = 0\), 即 \(\lim_{n \to \infty} x_n = 0\).

(I) 由 \(\sum_{i=1}^{3} a_{ij} = 0\), 知 \(a_{1j} + a_{2j} + a_{3j} = 0 (j = 1, 2, 3)\), 即 \(A\) 的每一列元素之和均为零. 由 \(A\) 是实对称矩阵, 知 \(A\) 的每一行元素之和均为零, 即
\[
\mathbf {A} \left[ \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right] = \mathbf {0} = 0 \left[ \begin{array}{l} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{array} \right]
\]
故 A 有特征值  \( \lambda_{1}=0 \) ，其特征向量  \( \alpha_{1}=(1,1,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \) .
设 A 的二重特征值  \( \lambda_{2} = \lambda_{3} = 1 \)  对应的特征向量为  \( \boldsymbol{X} = (x_{1}, x_{2}, x_{3})^{\mathrm{T}} \) ，由实对称矩阵的不同特征值对应的特征向量必正交，有
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = x _ {1} + x _ {2} + x _ {3} = 0
\]
解得  \( \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(-1,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{3}=(1,1,-2)^{\mathrm{T}} \)  (已正交), 将  \( \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3} \)  单位化, 有
\[
\gamma_ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} (1, 1, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (- 1, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \gamma_ {3} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} (1, 1, - 2) ^ {\mathrm{T}}
\]
令  \( Q=(\gamma_{1},\gamma_{2},\gamma_{3})=\begin{bmatrix}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}&-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}&\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}&\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}&\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}&0&-\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}}\end{bmatrix} \) ，则 Q 为正交矩阵.
又 \(Q^{-1}AQ = \Lambda = \mathrm{diag}(0,1,1)\) ，故由 \(\mathbf{X}^{\mathrm{T}}\mathbf{A}\mathbf{X}\xlongequal{\mathbf{X} = \mathbf{Q}\mathbf{Y}}0\cdot y_1^2 +y_2^2 +y_3^2 = 0\) ，知
\[
y _ {1} = C, \quad y _ {2} = 0, \quad y _ {3} = 0 \quad (\mathrm{C} \text {为任意常数})
\]
故  \( X = QY = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & 0 & -\frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} C \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix} = C \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{bmatrix} \) 为方程 \( X^{T}AX = 0 \) 的全部解.
(Ⅱ)由(Ⅰ)知，
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} \stackrel {\boldsymbol {X} = \boldsymbol {Q Y}} {=} \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {\Lambda}) \boldsymbol {Y} = \boldsymbol {Y} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \left[ \begin{array}{l l l} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \boldsymbol {Y} = 2 y _ {1} ^ {2} + y _ {2} ^ {2} + y _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \( \left\{\begin{aligned}y_{1}&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}z_{1}\\ y_{2}&=z_{2}\\ y_{3}&=z_{3}\end{aligned}\right. \) ，即Y= \( \begin{bmatrix}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}&0&0\\ 0&1&0\\ 0&0&1\end{bmatrix}Z\xlongequal{记}BZ \) ，则
\[
\boldsymbol {X} ^ {\mathrm{T}} (2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}) \boldsymbol {X} \xlongequal {\boldsymbol {X} = Q B Z} z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + z _ {3} ^ {2}
\]
令 \(P_{1} = QB\) ，则 \(\pmb{P}_1^{\mathrm{T}}(2\pmb {E} - \pmb {A})\pmb{P}_1 = \pmb{E}\) ，故
\[
2 \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A} = (\boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}}) ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1} = (\boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1}) ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {P} _ {1} ^ {- 1}
\]
令 \(P = P_{1}^{-1} = (QB)^{-1} = B^{-1}Q^{-1} = B^{-1}Q^{\mathrm{T}}\)
\[
= \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \sqrt {2} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{array} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {3}} \\ - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & - \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \\ - \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} & 0 \\ \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & \frac {1}{\sqrt {6}} & - \frac {2}{\sqrt {6}} \end{array} \right]
\]
则  \( \boldsymbol{X}^{\mathrm{T}}(2\boldsymbol{E}-\boldsymbol{A})\boldsymbol{X}=\boldsymbol{X}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{P}^{\mathrm{T}}\boldsymbol{P}\boldsymbol{X}=(\boldsymbol{P}\boldsymbol{X})^{\mathrm{T}}(\boldsymbol{P}\boldsymbol{X})=\|\boldsymbol{P}\boldsymbol{X}\| \) .

questions.stem:
设随机变量X与Y相互独立,且均服从 \( N(0,1) \) ,记
\[
U = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 1, \\ 0, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, \end{array} \right. V = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 2 \\ 0, & X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 2 \end{array} \right.
\]
(I) 求  \( (U, V) \)  的概率分布;
(II) 求  \( \rho_{UV} \) .

solution.analysis_md:
(I) 由已知, \((X, Y)\) 的概率密度为
\[
f (x, y) = f _ {X} (x) \cdot f _ {Y} (y) = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} (x ^ {2} + y ^ {2})}
\]
其中 \(-\infty < x < +\infty, -\infty < y < +\infty\) ，故
\[
P \{U = 0 \} = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1 \} = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 1} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {1} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} r ^ {2}} r \mathrm{d} r = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2}}
\]
\[
P \{V = 0 \} = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 2 \} = \iint_ {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} \leqslant 2} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = \frac {1}{2 \pi} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \theta \int_ {0} ^ {\sqrt {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2} r ^ {2}} r \mathrm{d} r = 1 - \mathrm{e} ^ {- 1}
\]
\[
P \{U = 0, V = 1 \} = P \{X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} \leqslant 1, X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2} > 2 \} = 0
\]
